name: Palemane Rock
summary: Palemane Rock shelters a gnoll camp in Mulgore's western mountains. The Palemane tribe holds the cave and foothills, threatening tauren near Bloodhoof Village.

sections.title: A Gnoll Stronghold
sections.body: Palemane Rock lies along Mulgore's western rim, where open grassland meets the mountains. An encampment fronts a deep cave in the mountainside. Palemane gnolls claim the cave and the foothills outside it as their territory. They attack hunters, travelers, and scouts who come too close, and defend their den fiercely.

faq.answer: Palemane Rock is a cave and gnoll settlement in Mulgore's western cliffs.
Palemane gnolls hold the cave and surrounding camp. They defend their territory against outsiders, including tauren.

faq.q: Why does Palemane Rock matter to the tauren?
faq.answer: Palemane Rock lies near central Mulgore and Bloodhoof Village. Hostile raiders from the camp keep tauren hunters and braves busy suppressing them.

angles.text: The Palemane gnolls in these western caves threaten game and unwary travelers across your people's pastures in Mulgore.
Keeping Mulgore's borders safe from Palemane gnolls helps protect the tauren homeland.
